slides.title: The WhatsApp button.
slides.body: Most visitors won't fill a form. One tap to WhatsApp turns a visit into a conversation.

slides.title: The first sentence.
slides.body: Say what you do and what to do next — in five seconds. “Welcome to our website” says neither.

slides.title: The first second.
slides.body: Before design, before words: speed. Compressed images, clean code and good hosting make it load before they leave.
